If the raw value for a temporal property value is not a string,
warn and discard the date.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            name:
            -   value: Entry with Bad Date
                # date requires a string.
                date: [array, instead, of, string]
            -   value: Entry with Good Date
                date: "2012-05-22"

-- want-errors --
persons\[someone\].Properties.name\[0\]: date discarded: expected date string, got

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    someone:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
                entries:
                -   value: StringValue{"Entry with Bad Date"}
                    # Bad date discarded, but value retained.
                -   value: StringValue{"Entry with Good Date"}
                    date: "2012-05-22"
